title: Cozy Living Room: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Cottagecore Interior Designs Featuring Hygge Spaces, Fireplaces, Bookshelves, and Warm Home Scenes for Relaxation
description:
Step into the coziest living rooms and feel the warmth of home on every page.


This delightful coloring book is a celebration of cozy interior spaces and the cottagecore lifestyle. Each page features a beautifully illustrated living room filled with plush sofas draped in quilts, crackling fireplaces, overflowing bookshelves, steaming cups of tea on side tables, soft candlelight, and houseplants in every corner. Every scene is drawn with bold, thick outlines and a warm, hygge-inspired aesthetic that makes coloring feel like wrapping yourself in a cozy blanket.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique cozy living room illustrations with bold, easy-to-color outlines
• Fireplaces, bookshelves, window seats, reading nooks, and candle-lit corners
• Cottagecore details — quilts, houseplants, tea sets, knitted throws, and vintage decor
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages for comfortable coloring
• Perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and stress relief with cozy vibes
• A wonderful gift for interior design and home decor lovers
• Hygge-inspired coloring sessions on rainy afternoons
• All skill levels — beginners to experienced colorists

Grab your colors and settle into these cozy spaces.
Every page is a warm invitation to slow down and breathe.
